items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He say, "I need you, I need you."

ctx.x: I think I went down at Wheeler Music with Sid Wycher (Unaudible) was doing a lot of things.
So I was walking up Broadway and here come Cab's manager running down the street. He say, "I need you, I need you."
He says, "Did you hear about Chu Berry's accident?"
